name: Roo Hsing Co., Ltd
summary: Roo Hsing Co., Ltd. specializes in the textile and apparel industry within Taiwan, engaging in the manufacturing, processing, and trading of a wide array of clothing items. Its product range includes knitwear, woven goods, and garments crafted from materials such as cotton, wool, and leather, encompassing specific items like trousers, skirts, dresses, shirts, jackets, vests, pants, and sport suits. The company also handles the processing, sale, import, and export of apparel accessories. Beyond its core textile operations, Roo Hsing provides agency services, facilitating bids, quotes, procurement, and distribution for both domestic and international entities. The company has also diversified its interests, engaging in electronic component trading, plant and property leasing, real estate transactions, and the development of funeral homes. Founded in 1977 and based in Taipei, Taiwan, the company was initially known as Roo Hsing Garment Co., Ltd. before officially adopting its current name, Roo Hsing Co., Ltd., in June 2008.
